ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The figure below schematically shows the different links in the runoff process of a certain drainage basin. <image1> When the amount of precipitation is the same, what effect will dense vegetation cover have on which link in the runoff process?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The diagram shows the runoff process of a certain drainage basin. At the top is “precipitation,” branching downward and to both sides into links such as “evaporation” and “interception,” and subsequently connecting to channel precipitation, surface runoff, underground runoff, groundwater flow, and total runoff, etc. Then reason: The question specifies that the amount of precipitation is the same, and the changing factor is dense vegetation cover. The denser the vegetation, the stronger the interception effect of tree canopies, branches and leaves, and surface litter on precipitation; therefore it mainly affects the “interception/intercepting” link in the figure, manifested as an increase in intercepted rainwater.

raw_record.question_text:
The figure below schematically shows the different links in the runoff process of a certain drainage basin.

<image1>

When the amount of precipitation is the same, what effect will dense vegetation cover have on which link in the runoff process?

method.method_draft: 先读图：图中径流过程从“降水”开始，分出“蒸发”“截流”，再进入河道降水、地表径流、地下径流等环节。再读题：条件是“降水量相同”，变化因素是“植被覆盖密”。用地理知识判断，植被越密，树冠、枝叶、枯落物对降水的拦截作用越强，因此对应图中的“截流”环节，影响表现为截留的雨水增多。答案写为：截留雨水多。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图示为某流域径流过程，顶部是“降水”，向下和两侧分出“蒸发”“截流”等环节，后续连接到河道降水、地表径流、地下径流、地下水流和总径流等。再推理：题目限定降水量相同，变化因素是植被覆盖密。植被越密，树冠、枝叶和地表枯落物对降水的拦截作用越强，因此主要影响图中的“截流/截留”环节，表现为截留的雨水增多。
method.model_answer: 截流（截留）环节；截留雨水多。
